comment: The twelve note buttons are ordinary switches and can each be clicked; the display beside them is a custom widget with no ParamWidget. The SCL knob is a snapped parameter over -12 to +12 with a custom quantity that prints the scale name (SickoQuant.cpp:287). The keyboard, the SCL knob and the PROG knob all feed the same working scale, which is why SET and AUTO apply to all three.
